summary: Man and woman in their 20s became disoriented while hiking near Lake Haiyaha in the Bear Lake area due to snow-covered trails; rangers tried to guide them with lights Tuesday night, advised them to stay put, and reached them at 7 a.m. Wednesday, escorting them out
location: Near Lake Haiyaha, Bear Lake area, Rocky Mountain National Park
notes: One of three SAR operations reported Thu Jun 30, 2011. Date = the Tuesday-night call per the report; weekday-verified.
